Glossary

cumulative lifenote ID an ID assigned to a lifenote based on how it ranks cumulatively after another in a single day.

index n. a file that organizes tags from lifenotes in one place.

lifenote n. a piece of text, image, or other expressive medium used in the LifeNotes system.

LifeNotes n. an indexed organization system for journaling.

lifetab n. a section inside LifeNotes depicting a major category. Life, work, poetry, etc.

tag n. a keyword or label used to trace a lifenote back to the index.

unfiled adj. a lifenote that has not been indexed or put in an appropriate folder yet.
